checks.name: independent_indicator_and_cvpat_reference
checks.detail: The independent Python oracle reproduces the seeded SHA-256 10x10 plan, train-only recursive indicator prediction, IA/LM metrics, and one-sided paired CVPAT statistics.

checks.name: current_engine_and_validation_contract
checks.detail: The executable v2 engine uses the exact versioned fold/CVPAT contract and blocks unsupported endogenous, missing-data, resampling, interaction, HOC, and case-weight shapes.

checks.name: strict_archive_and_legacy_boundary
checks.detail: Current v2 results append/save/reopen only after strict payload validation; v1 construct-score archives remain readable and visibly legacy without being accepted as new v2 evidence.

checks.name: native_results_and_export_are_indicator_first
checks.detail: Native Results default to indicator prediction, show explicit IA/LM availability and single-model CVPAT, preserve blank unavailable numerics with reasons, and export the exact fold digest/provenance.

checks.name: genuine_packaged_native_workflow
checks.detail: A genuine packaged Tauri run must visibly author the model, run v2, capture active progress, inspect indicator/CVPAT tables, create a native XLSX, and reopen the exact saved result.

checks.name: bounded_scope_and_legacy_docs
checks.detail: The current method note documents the exact fixed indicator/CVPAT scope and the v1 note remains archive-only rather than being relabeled as current evidence.

limitations: The fixed seeded 10x10 plan is independently implemented and does not reproduce SmartPLS random fold assignments.
CVPAT compares one fitted PLS model with IA and LM benchmarks; separately saved-model comparison remains outside this workflow.
Formative endogenous constructs, HOCs, interactions, case weights, non-listwise missing-data handling, and external inference mixing remain unsupported.
